oldham.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Oldham
s1loc: Oldham runs a busy live scene from its town centre. The Queen Elizabeth Hall on West Street takes the big standing concerts and gigs, with a dance floor that holds well over a thousand, the Oldham Coliseum carries the theatre tradition, and stage productions run on through the year. Outdoors, Festival Oldham fills the town centre each summer with street theatre, music and dance across more than fifty performances, while the Great Garden Carnival brings costumed parades to the streets.
